Estimator – Full-Time
Location: Welshpool, Western Australia 6106
Employment Type: Full-Time
Salary: $90,000 – $120,000 per annum (depending on skills and experience)

MINPROVISE INTERNATIONAL PTY LTD is a leading total solutions provider delivering specialist maintenance and shutdown services, engineering, fabrication, project services, and sustaining capital works. We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking an experienced and motivated Estimator to join our growing team on a full-time basis.
About the Role

As an Estimator, you will be responsible for preparing accurate cost estimates, tenders, and quotations for engineering, fabrication, maintenance, shutdown, and industrial projects. You will work closely with project managers, engineers, procurement teams, suppliers, subcontractors, and clients to assess project requirements, develop competitive pricing, and support successful project delivery.

Key Responsibilities
•	Review project drawings, specifications, scopes of work, and tender documentation.
•	Prepare detailed cost estimates, quotations, and tender submissions for projects.
•	Analyse labour, materials, equipment, subcontractor, and project-related costs.
•	Conduct quantity take-offs and prepare cost breakdowns based on project requirements.
•	Obtain and evaluate supplier and subcontractor quotations.
•	Liaise with project managers, engineers, clients, and suppliers to clarify project requirements.
•	Assist with tender preparation, pricing strategies, and commercial submissions.
•	Monitor market conditions, material costs, and industry trends affecting project pricing.
•	Identify potential project risks, cost variations, and opportunities for improvement.
•	Maintain accurate estimating records, databases, and historical cost information.
•	Assist project teams with budget preparation, cost tracking, and variation assessments.
•	Ensure all estimating activities comply with company procedures, quality standards, and client requirements.
•	Support continuous improvement of estimating processes and systems.

Skills and Experience
•	Minimum 1-2 years of full-time experience as an Estimator or in a similar estimating role.
•	Experience within mining, engineering, fabrication, construction, or industrial sectors is highly regarded.
•	Strong understanding of project costing, estimating principles, and tender processes.
•	Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, technical specifications, and scopes of work.
•	Strong analytical and numerical skills with high attention to detail.
•	Ability to prepare accurate cost estimates within required timeframes.
•	Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
•	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and estimating/project management software.
•	Ability to work independently and as part of a project team.

What We Offer
•	Full-time, permanent employment.
•	Competitive salary of $90,000 – $120,000 per annum.
•	Opportunities to work on major mining, shutdown, engineering, and industrial projects.
•	Ongoing training and career development.
•	Supportive team environment with long-term career opportunities.

We also provide a comprehensive range of equipment and products, supporting the mining, oil & gas, and construction industries across Australia and internationally.

We are currently seeking experienced and motivated Boilermakers to join our growing team on a full-time basis.
About the Role

As a Boilermaker, you will be responsible for fabricating, assembling, installing, maintaining, and repairing structural steel, pressure vessels, heavy equipment, and metal components used in mining, industrial, and construction projects. You will work closely with engineers, supervisors, and maintenance teams to ensure all fabrication and welding work is completed safely, efficiently, and in accordance with engineering specifications and Australian Standards.

Key Responsibilities
•	Read and interpret engineering drawings, blueprints, fabrication plans, and technical specifications.
•	Fabricate, assemble, install, and repair structural steel, heavy machinery components, tanks, chutes, hoppers, conveyors, and other metal 
structures.
•	Mark out, cut, shape, bend, and prepare metal materials using fabrication equipment.
•	Perform welding using MIG, TIG, Stick, and Flux-Cored Arc Welding (FCAW) processes as required.
•	Carry out maintenance and repairs on plant and mining equipment during shutdowns and ongoing operations.
•	Inspect fabricated and welded components to ensure compliance with quality standards and engineering specifications.
•	Safely operate welding equipment, hand tools, power tools, cranes, hoists, and workshop machinery.
•	Identify faults, perform modifications, and recommend repair solutions where required.
•	Maintain accurate records of fabrication, repairs, inspections, and completed work.
•	Work collaboratively with engineers, supervisors, and other tradespeople to complete projects on time.
•	Assist with training apprentices and junior team members where required.

Skills and Experience

•	Strong welding, fabrication, and metalworking skills.
•	Experience working with structural steel, heavy equipment, and industrial or mining plant.

•	Opportunities to work on major mining, shutdown, and industrial projects.
•	Ongoing training and career development.
•	Supportive team environment with long-term career opportunities.

Summary

Our client is seeking to add a Civil Engineering Draftsperson to its residential building and construction business based in Guildford, New South Wales. Ozi Homes Pty Ltd supports the planning and delivery of residential construction projects and requires a capable draftsperson to prepare accurate civil engineering drawings, technical plans and supporting documentation across construction, site development and project coordination activities.

The typical job responsibilities will include, but are not limited to the following:

- Preparing detailed civil engineering drawings and technical plans for construction and infrastructure projects.
- Producing site layouts, drainage plans and structural drafting documentation using CAD software.
- Assisting engineers with drafting support across residential and commercial building developments.
- Reviewing engineering sketches and converting concepts into accurate technical construction drawings.
- Preparing plans for stormwater, sewerage and civil infrastructure construction works.
- Interpreting engineering instructions and applying drafting procedures to project documentation requirements.
- Coordinating drawing revisions based on engineering feedback and construction site requirements.
- Maintaining accurate drawing registers, technical records and drafting version control procedures.
- Liaising with engineers, project managers and contractors regarding drafting updates and specifications.
- Ensuring engineering drawings comply with Australian standards, regulations and contract requirements.
- Preparing sketches, charts and tabulated information supporting engineering and construction activities.
- Conducting quantity calculations and assisting with material estimation for civil construction projects.
- Supporting construction teams with technical drafting information during project delivery stages.
- Inspecting completed drafting work to ensure accuracy, consistency and compliance requirements.
- Assisting with project coordination and resolving drafting discrepancies during construction activities.

Applicants must meet the following minimum requirements to be considered for the role:

- Diploma or Advanced Diploma qualification in Civil Engineering Drafting, Engineering Design or closely related technical discipline.
- Minimum 12 months experience preparing civil engineering drawings using industry-standard CAD drafting software within construction environments.
- Comprehensive understanding of Australian construction standards, engineering documentation requirements and relevant regulatory compliance obligations.
- Ability to interpret technical engineering information and prepare accurate construction and infrastructure drafting documentation independently.
- Experience supporting residential and commercial construction projects with high levels of drafting accuracy and technical detail.
- Well-developed communication skills when liaising with engineers, contractors, project managers and external construction stakeholders professionally.
- Strong organisational abilities managing multiple drafting priorities while maintaining documentation accuracy and project delivery deadlines consistently.
- Practical knowledge of drainage, sewerage, infrastructure and site development drafting within Australian construction project environments.

Please include Reference: J1690-Workforce in the Subject Line and email all applications and CV to apply@jobsource.net.au

Due to the volume of applicants, only those meeting the minimum standards will be considered and only successful applicants will be contacted.  Thank you for your interest in the role.
